summary: Prepare bankable tenders, assess bids and strengthen award governance. Explore practical renewable-energy procurement training and enquire today.
lede: Renewable energy tendering training helps procurement, planning, finance and project professionals prepare and assess competitive generation tenders. It develops skills in project-readiness and site screening, grid assessment, bid-rule design, risk allocation, tariff affordability and financial-indicator comparison, using evaluation templates and spreadsheet analysis to support documented scoring and award recommendations.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who shape renewable-energy procurement decisions, prepare bankable projects or assess bids and award recommendations. It connects project, procurement, finance and regulatory responsibilities.
prerequisites: Recommended preparation: familiarity with energy projects, public procurement, utility planning or project finance. No coding or programming is required. Bring a laptop with access to Excel for spreadsheet-based bid comparisons; no specialist software installation is required.
